notes: GAAP city, fiscal year ended 9/30/2022. Governmental lines from the Total Governmental Funds column (p4); business-type from the Combined Utilities Fund statement (p6). Business-type receipts/disbursements totals = operating + nonoperating (no single printed total; the printed 'Total non-operating expenses' (209,118) nets interest income 612). Ending cash/investments from the governmental funds balance sheet (p3); no beginning cash printed. Statement 'Miscellaneous' 92,402 includes ARP Fund receipts 22,963 (printed as Miscellaneous in the ARP column, p10), kept as one Total-column line. Sales tax 333,906 is broken down on the Statement of Activities (p2) into Public Safety Services Agency indebtedness 166,953 and infrastructure improvements 166,953; kept one line (already sales tax). Governmental detail: the only governmental budget schedule is a combined budgetary-basis comparison for all governmental funds (p9, Property taxes / State receipts / Local receipts groups), so detail is one line per fund column of the governmental funds statement (p4: General, Debt Service, Sales Tax) plus the nonmajor combining schedule (p10: CDBG, ARP; Housing had no activity); the p9 budget schedule is not recorded (double counting). Utility detail from the combining departmental schedule (p11), department columns Electric/Water/Sewer/Sanitation; nonoperating lines and capital contributions are printed only in the Total column. Proprietary cash flows p7 (no noncapital financing section). Governmental roll: 1,618,886 + 1,793,433 - 1,829,673 + 48,230 - 48,230 = 1,582,646. Business: 2,511,519 + 1,249,344 - 1,103,179 + 19,588 = 2,677,272. Read pages 1-11 of 11
